candidate.definition_en: A position from which something is observed or considered; a point of view.
candidate.explanation_ar: وجهة نظر.. الطريقة اللي بتشوف بيها الأمور أو المكان اللي بتبص منه.

senses.definition_en: A position from which something is observed or considered; a point of view.
senses.definition_ar: وجهة نظر أو زاوية رؤية للأمور
examples: From my viewpoint, it was a mistake.
We need to consider the customer's viewpoint.
The novel is written from the viewpoint of a child.
